title: SkillsFuture course completion rates and fee waiver appeals
asked: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked for SkillsFuture Singapore drop-out rates by stage and course category, the number of learner appeals to waive course fees or penalties for non-completion or failure, the share that succeeded, and employment or certification rates based on all enrolled learners rather than graduates only.
response: In 2025, more than 90% of learners completed their SSG courses. SSG does not process course fee waiver requests for learners who fail to complete; waivers fall under the contract between learner and training provider, and SSG encourages providers to work with learners on solutions such as deferments, make-up lessons or reassessments. For place-and-train work-study programmes, more than nine in 10 graduates were employed six months after completion, and these statistics exclude learners who did not complete the programme. On refunds, once payment is made any refund follows the training provider's refund policy, and successful refunds of SkillsFuture credits are reinstated into the learner's wallet.
